independentRawArtReview.method: Direct visual comparison of downloaded original and candidate Chromium native RAW at 65.25/66.35/68.05; no concept render substituted.
positives: R25 eliminates much of the repetitively busy old L-bank environment; more sky and empty areas; native B51 warning and road remain visibly present.
rejectionReasons: 65.25: elongated, flat gray horizontal foreground beam on left still dominates and hides the tidal industrial story; feature river reads as narrow cyan ribbon.
66.35: broad untextured gray wedge on near-left; distant small blocks look isolated rather than integrated work harbor; right-bank layered slabs still generic.
68.05: water reads as flat cyan wedge; repeated right dark-gray structural planes and preexisting isolated turbine compete, no visible functioning headrace-to-caisson-to-quay narrative.
Most of actual group 06 gate geometry is at or below 0.1941% impact at a single clean snapshot, zero at most other clean snapshots. Waterfall 05 and leaves 07 are similarly not legible.

At roughly 180-191 m/s the essential spatial hierarchy, risk visibility, maritime function, and human fun are not validated. The present module is closer to an authored blockout than a polished art-quality integrated world.
